annotations.title: Send the link to everyone, and get the tap that puts it in a group chat.

description: Emails the invitation once to every person added with an address, and hands back a tap that opens WhatsApp, a text or a mail draft with the message and the link already written, for the family group and for anyone with no address. Nobody is written to twice by this tool, and a caller sends a limited number of emails a day.

also_email.description: Leave it out to send the invitation. Set it false to get the taps only and send nothing.
